chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn Ismail from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from the one who narrated to him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the sick man who divorces his wife while he is sick, he (peace be upon him) said: If he dies in that illness of his, and she is residing with him and has not remarried, she inherits him; and if she has remarried, then she is content with what was done, and there is no inheritance for her.
ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit her husband if he divorces her while sick and then dies from that same illness?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the legal status of 'ghurba' (divorce during illness) by establishing that remarriage serves as an implicit acceptance of the husband's prior act of divorcing her, thereby extinguishing her right to inherit. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle that the timing of death relative to the divorce decree determines the continuity of the marital bond for inheritance purposes, distinguishing it from standard post-divorce waiting periods.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, together from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj, from the one who narrated it,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the sick man who divorces his wife during illness’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he dies in that illness of his, and she is residing with him and has not re-married, she would inherit him, and if she has re-married, so she is happy with that which has been done, and then there is no inheritance for her’.
en.sarwar: 7. Abu Ali al-Ash ‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from all from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from those who narrated to him who has narrated the following: “About the case of a man who is ill and divorces his wife, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If he dies from that illness and she stays for him unmarried, she inherits him, but if she has married then she has accepted what he has done, thus, there is no inheritance for her.’”
